notes: Net map (6 nodes): 0 = bottom rail at y~330-335, carrying the lower lead of V-DC 0 (down from the circle at x~105), the GND 5 stem at x~279, the bottom lead of resistor 6 (50ohm) at x~350 and the bottom lead of I-DC 2 at x~408. n1 = upper lead of V-DC 0 up to the corner (107,176) and right into the LEFT end of resistor 7 (49ohm). n2 = the node at (235,186): right lead of resistor 7, continuing right into the LEFT plate of capacitor 3 (51mF), and a branch running down x~235 to (235,245) then right into the LEFT end of inductor 1 (55mH) -- a clean three-way T verified at 8x. n3 = RIGHT plate of capacitor 3 to the LEFT end of inductor 4 (54uH). n4 = RIGHT end of inductor 4 right to the corner (408,193) then down into the TOP of I-DC 2. n5 = RIGHT end of inductor 1 right to (350,249) then down into the TOP of resistor 6.
